thread:
maya: Quick preflight for branching release/1.13 — planning to cut in ~2h.

maya: Need: version bump PR merged, changelog entries in changelog/1.13.md, and backport requests filed.

jonathan: On version bump — PR #4821 has the bump but CI flaky. Do we want to block on CI green or force-merge with rollback plan?

ana: Changelog: I added skeleton entries for infra and runtime, but need product to fill features. @lina can you add bullets?

kevin-bot: [CI status] PR #4821 build: flaky_tests_failure. Failing jobs: integration-e2e (timeout). Recommend rerun.

sam: Cutoff time reminder: I'm ok with 2h from now (17:00 PDT). That's 00:00 UTC. Does that work for infra ops?

maya: We will not force-merge. Plan: rerun CI once; if still failing, tag as flaky and proceed with an immediate post-cut rollback runbook. Also, we will gate any db-migration PRs.

jonathan: Backport rules check: only bugfixes and critical infra patches get backported to release/* automatically. For others, open explicit cherry-pick PRs targeting release/1.13 and add label backport/release-1.13.

ana: For cherry-picks, prefer using `git cherry-pick -x <sha>` and push to branch `backport/<issue>-1.13`, then open PR. Example in case: ```git checkout -b backport/4821-1.13 release/1.13
git cherry-pick -x 7f3e2ab
git push origin backport/4821-1.13```

lina: Added changelog bullets for product features. Left TODOs for PM to expand. Link: https://docs.internal/changelog/1.13

sam: Who's coordinating the actual branch creation and the tag? I can handle the tag after branch is up.

maya: I'll cut release/1.13 branch from main in ~90m. @jonathan can you watch for any urgent cherry-pick requests before I cut? Put requests in this thread with PR link.

jonathan: Will watch. If someone needs an emergency backport after cut, we do patch release flow.

kevin-bot: [deploy-bot] Pre-cut checks: outstanding security review: 2 items (authn middleware), infra migrations: none, docs: changelog TODOs. All green for cut with reviewer ack.

maya: Final ask: please ping here with a single-line ack once your item is done (changelog, version bump, backports). I'll proceed on first all-clear or after 90 minutes whichever comes first.

ana: ack — changelog updated (skeleton filled, awaiting PM).

lina: ack — added bullets.

jonathan: ack — monitoring PR CI reruns.

sam: ack — available for tagging.

maya: Thanks all. Cutting on schedule unless someone posts blocker in next 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin-bot: reaction: :white_check_mark: on message maya
